content: Projective texture blending uses a winner-takes-most weighting scheme with a narrow transition when qualities are nearly equal. Primary and secondary panos are sampled via equirectangular UV mapping from world positions, then weighted by visibility, quality, and dominance factors based on blend mode (0=secondary only, 1=primary only, 2=primary-favored, 3=secondary-favored). A debug coverage mode visualizes four states: red/cyan/magenta/white. Single-projector output is never mixed with fallback when secondary projector is unavailable.
